job_title: Entry-Level Web Developer - TS/SCI Poly Clearance
job_description: Nyla Technology Solutions in Maryland is looking for an entry-level Software Engineer to join a dedicated team building and supporting web-based services in AWS. Candidates should have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and be open to learning and growing through mentorship. The role offers opportunities to implement features, maintain applications, and troubleshoot issues. The annual salary range is $114,000-$135,000, along with a comprehensive benefits package.
